title: Who You Want to Be
caption:
Who You Want to Be

The colour that suits you, the colour you love, and the colour that suits the woman you want to be are not always the same.

A colour that goes with today's outfit is easy to find.
So is a colour that brightens your skin.
I can see it quickly. So can AI.

What we cannot see is who you want to be.

That is why every session begins with listening.
Your mood today. The image you have in mind. The life you live every day.
Then I choose the makeup that suits that version of you.

Before we begin, tell me: how do you want to feel today?
